name: evolver-agent-plugin
description: Evolver for AI agents as one plugin, with no tools: recalls one EvoMap strategy per prompt, tags edits with improvement signals, reports each reuse with the evidence the turn produced, and distills verified turns into drafts you publish or discard. Claude Code is the first supported host.

proxy_port.title: Proxy port
proxy_port.description: Loopback Proxy fallback port when ~/.evolver/settings.json names none. Blank uses $EVOMAP_PROXY_PORT, then 19820.

recall_enabled.title: Recall a strategy per prompt
recall_enabled.description: Look one reusable EvoMap strategy up per turn and inject it behind that turn's prompt.

recall_wait_ms.title: Recall wait (ms)
recall_wait_ms.description: How long turn.start waits on recall before finishing it in the background; the strategy reaches the model from a later step either way.

auto_distill.title: Distill verified turns
auto_distill.description: After a turn that edited files and ended on a passing check, read the lesson back with one forked completion and keep it as a draft for /evolver-drafts. Each distillation spends tokens from your plan.

claim_nudge_enabled.title: Claim reminders
claim_nudge_enabled.description: Show a toast with the pending EvoMap node-claim link at most every 12 hours.

node_path.title: Node executable
node_path.description: Node.js 22.13+ used for git capture and the local reuse ledger.
